safety: one authoritative core and event envelope
idempotency key blocks duplicate effects
import preview and validation before write
snapshot before restore, migration, or import promotion
encrypted write followed by decrypt and durable read-back
rollback with raw-vault read-back on failure
strict reversal topology with legacy one-to-one compatibility
no direct deletion of protected history
pre-4.2 obligations retain original total-split semantics
cancelled records are filtered before live render/list counting and remain in durable history
Calendar source HTML omits cancelled counter and cancelled filter; cancelled records remain in durable history
Calendar month and list use the same green/yellow/red status signal
owner dashboard reads current cash, stock and live Calendar state without mutating durable data
owner dashboard red metric counts only active outgoing items due in the current month and displays item count only
4.2.5 owns the visible product version through one shared runtime authority value
daily target progress is derived from current-day Store sales plus Ride jobs and does not create competing money truth
end-day obligation selection previews the resulting balance without mutation; stale or VERIFY items remain disabled
confirmed end-day obligation payments use existing Ledger and Calendar mutation paths and one durable commit
FLOW_ICONS is the shared geometry authority for METROPOLIS core and utility glyphs
index.html owns the single five-destination bottom navigation source; METROPOLIS v4 only hydrates icons and syncs active state
METROPOLIS is the primary visible product name and YGPH — Yggdrasil Personal Helper is its signature
manual stock adjustment records before, delta, after, reason, actor and time without creating an automatic Ledger transaction
manual stock adjustment history lives in state.store.adjustments without changing state schema or IndexedDB version
historical stock reports use the latest physical adjustment as an anchor through the afterReport maintenance adapter instead of rewriting app.js report logic
partial reset preserves durable sales, purchases, ride jobs, Ledger transactions and source-linked Calendar history
Factory Reset deletes the complete stock-pocket-secure IndexedDB so Vault, rollback data and trusted-device key are removed together
Full Local Cleanup additionally removes METROPOLIS app/meta caches and unregisters the current service worker, and is blocked while offline
destructive reset requires typed confirmation and database deletion read-back before success
maintenance logic, browser reset adapter, report adapter and UI styles are separate production modules to reduce future rewiring
finalization and maintenance rollout do not change Vault format, state schema, database identity, or existing money ownership semantics
production manifest, Cloudflare allowlist and offline shell are regression-locked against drift
every production UI change advances the service-worker cache/release generation

serviceWorker.note: METROPOLIS 4.2.5 maintenance center adds auditable stock reconciliation, safe partial resets, typed-confirmation Factory Reset, Full Local Cleanup, and an isolated report adapter. Trusted-device auto-unlock and all existing money/data ownership semantics remain unchanged.

manualUpload: Extract the ZIP at repository root.
Overwrite files with the same names and paths.
Do not rename production files or add version suffixes.
Run npm run deploy:gate before Cloudflare deployment.
